name: Small DC motors (under ~36V)
summary: Small brushed DC motors under about 36V, often with a gearbox: toys, tools, vehicles and printers.
uses: Small generators (hand crank, pedal, water wheel)
Wiper and window motors make strong winches and gate drives
identify: Metal cans with two terminals, from tiny toy motors to big wiper motors. In cordless drills, car seats, windows and wipers, toys, printers, massagers, and 24V wheelchair and scooter drives.
test: Touch it to a battery: it should spin, and reverse when the wires swap. Spin it by hand with a meter on it to check it works as a generator.
